description: This file contains the implementation of the Analytics system, including class definitions, configuration, event handling, and backend communication logic for the Analytics feature within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: AnalyticsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for analytics, holding JSON configuration parameters such as event map and backend library.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the analytics logic, including event queuing, configuration, backend communication, and event mapping.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper
classes.description: Helper class for mapping event names based on configuration JSON.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::SendEvent
methods.description: Public method to enqueue an event for sending, with validation and logging.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics system with the provided shell, loads configuration, and initializes backends.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::ActionLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in a separate thread to process queued actions such as sending events and populating system time.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the system time is valid and synchronized.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Converts internal event to backend event format and sends it to the configured backend.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::ParseEventsMapFile
methods.description: Parses the event mapping JSON file to populate the event mapper.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::GetCurrentTimestampInMs
methods.description: Returns the current system timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::GetCurrentUptimeInMs
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in milliseconds.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts an uptime value to a system timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper::FromString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to populate the event name mapping.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper::MapEventNameIfNeeded
methods.description: Maps an event name based on the configured mappings, with fallback to original name.
